units.text: The claim that both Zena Cardman and Nicole Ayers rode Crew-11 from Kennedy Space Center in Florida on August 1, 2025 is false. NASA's official Crew-11 assignment lists Zena Cardman, Mike Fincke, Kimiya Yui, and Oleg Platonov; no August 1 date is provided, only a July 2025 window; and Nicole Ayers,

units.text: The claim adds Nicole Ayers to Crew-11, but NASA sources list four named astronauts (Cardman, Fincke, Yui, Platonov) and a separate Crew-10 mission with Ayers as pilot launching no earlier than February 2025.

units.text: The claim fixes August 1, 2025, while all NASA sources give only a July 2025 launch window with no specific date.
